{{TimeScaleTicket|3}}, {{Gem|110}}, {{Exp|385}} & 2 [[Blizzard Bomb]]s ([[All Paths]]) }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies have Nimble.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Vanguard''' is a [[Challenge Maps|challenge map]]. It uses a modified version of the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode as its mode. Triumphing this challenge rewards the player with {{Gem|100}}, {{Exp|350}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|3}} and two [[Blizzard Bomb]]s. However, the rewards can be higher if modifiers that affect rewards are present. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be gotten once a week. ==Changes== The main change in this challenge is all enemies have the [[Nimble]] attribute. Cash is also altered on this challenge. ===Enemies=== All enemy replacements from [[Enemies Beta]] are applied here. A few regular enemies also have their health values, which for most of them is changed to match their previous [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode health values. *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 4 health ({{Color|No|-6}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|No|-30}}) *[[Fallen]] - 180 health ({{Color|No|-45}}) *[[Necromancer King]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-61,000}}) *[[Cursed Skeleton]] - 500 ({{Color|No|-750}}) *[[Fallen Hero]] - 5,000 health ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-18,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] - 75,000 health ({{Color|No|-125,000}}) Any enemies that do not have their health altered in any way by the challenge or modifiers present on this map are affected by [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode's health scaling. Additionally, any enemy that has no set cash to give when killed or damaged enough will give {{Money|5}} on death. ===Wave Structure=== '''Bolded ''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. Due to the [[All Paths]] modifier present on the most recent map, all enemies are duplicated for each path except [[Fallen King]].

==Cash== Base cash is increased by {{Money|100}} in comparison to the regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, though wave bonus is unchanged. ==Strategy== *As all enemies move twice as fast due to the [[Nimble]] attribute, stalling towers such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Cryomancer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] are highly recommended. *Similar to other challenges, high DPS towers such as the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Gatling Gun]] are advised. **Do be aware that depending on the map, cliff spots may be limited or not in a good spot. **The [[Accelerator]] may not perform that well here without stalling towers, as multiple enemies with their speed boosted by [[Nimble]] could leave its range while it is charging up for a few seconds. ==Trivia== *'''Vanguard''' was first added into the game on the 21st of June 2024. However, it would take the challenge 114 days for it to actually appear. **During that period, the challenge received changes in the [[v1.27.0|Fallen Foes Update]], meaning the original version of '''Vanguard''' never got a chance to appear in-game. ==Challenge History== *'''13 October 2024 – 20 October 2024''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] *'''3 November 2024 – 10 November 2024''' **Map: [[Infernal Abyss]] *'''24 November 2024 – 1 December 2024''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] *'''19 January 2025 – 26 January 2025''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] *'''9 February 2025 – 15 February 2025''' **Map: [[Infernal Abyss]] *'''2 March 2025 – 9 March 2025''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] *'''20 April 2025 – 27 April 2025''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] *'''11 May 2025 – 18 May 2025''' **Map: [[Infernal Abyss]] *'''25 May 2025 – 1 June 2025''' **Map: [[Winter Stronghold]] ==Update History== *'''21 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0]] **'''Vanguard''' added. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **Now uses the new income system. **Updated to use the new [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode enemy appearances, some stats, health scaling and soundtracks. **Now changes more enemy health values. ***[[Abnormal]] health now changes to 6. ***[[Quick]] health now changes to 4. ***[[Heavy]] health now changes to 16. ***[[Breaker2]] health now changes to 50. ***[[Fallen]] health now changes to 180. ***[[Fallen Hero]] health now changes to 5,000. ***[[Fallen Guardian]] health now changes to 14,000. ***[[Fallen King]] health now changes to 75,000. **Disabled dialogue. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, the mode is set to [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode instead of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Vanguard''' can now be activated exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, as the challenges button in the lobby has been removed. {{ChallengeNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Vanguard}}
